title: The Dollars Trilogy
blurb: Three westerns with the same unnamed gunman — and a long-running argument that the most famous one is a prequel.

thegood66.t: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly

note: The prequel reading comes from The Good, the Bad and the Ugly being set during the Civil War and ending with the character acquiring his poncho. It's a popular theory rather than anything the films state. Release order works perfectly well.
